channel.title: Council of AI — signed measurement feed
channel.description: New signed measurement states from Council of AI (CSOAI LTD, UK #16939677). Every item links to a verifiable artifact. Measurement, not certification.

item.title: Swarm axis: first resolved ordering measured (37-item bank, n≥36/cell)
item.description: Swarm candidate bank v2b measured across 5 models. qwen2.5:7b lower-CI bound clears mistral:7b upper bound — the first separated ordering on the swarm axis. Signed board: SOVOS/boards-signed/board_swarm-candidates-v2b.signed.json

item.title: Fleet sweep v2: 165 signed boards across 11 models × 15 banks
item.description: Full fleet sweep on A100 with the estate harness (sovos_city.bench.board). Means across cells: nemotron-30b 0.749, phi4-14b 0.741, deepseek-r1-8b 0.687, gemma3-12b 0.667. All boards Ed25519-signed (estate-chain key), verifiable against did:web:csoai.org.

item.title: External anchors: frozen banks now third-party timestamped
item.description: The hash-sealed 818-item bank manifest is witnessed by RFC 3161 TSA (FreeTSA) and OpenTimestamps calendars. The measurement log is no longer self-asserted.
